A sovereign digital commerce stack is a custom-built infrastructure that allows online sellers to collect payments directly from their customers, without relying on third-party platforms. For example, NOWPayments allows sellers to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This means that sellers can provide instant payment confirmations to their customers, improving their overall user experience. Furthermore, cloud infrastructure providers like Cloudflare offer a range of tools and services that can be used to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, including edge computing, content delivery networks, and security features like SSL/TLS encryption and DDoS protection. How They Handle Restricted Countries

Most payment platforms, including those that offer crypto payment options, have restrictions in place for countries like Tanzania due to compliance and regulatory issues. However, a sovereign digital commerce stack can bypass these restrictions by using blockchain-based payment systems that operate on decentralized networks, which are not subject to the same regulatory requirements as traditional payment platforms. For example, NOWPayments allows sellers to accept payments in naira, cedis, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-internationally-complete|COREMERCH guide to kenyan]] shillings, and Pakistani rupees, which are not typically supported by other payment platforms. This makes it easier for Tanzanian online sellers to collect payments from customers, even in countries with restricted access to traditional payment platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

One of the key benefits of a sovereign digital commerce stack is the ability to process payments quickly and efficiently, without the need for intermediaries like banks or payment processors. For example, USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, making it an ideal choice for online sellers who need to process payments quickly. In contrast, traditional payment platforms often charge higher fees and may take longer to process payments, which can negatively impact the overall user experience and increase the risk of payment disputes. Furthermore, a sovereign digital commerce stack can also help to reduce the real costs of payment processing by eliminating the need for intermediaries and minimizing the risk of chargebacks and disputes.
The blockchain has no map of restricted countries — a wallet in Harare processes identically to one in Hamburg.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A sovereign digital commerce stack offers online sellers full ownership and control over their payment infrastructure, which means they can automate and customize their payment processes to meet the needs of their customers. This includes the ability to set up automatic payment confirmations, delivery notifications, and other features that can improve the overall user experience and increase customer satisfaction. Furthermore, a sovereign digital commerce stack can also help to streamline the delivery process by providing a centralized platform for managing orders, inventory, and shipping. This can help to reduce the risk of errors and delays, and improve the overall efficiency of the delivery process.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture for a sovereign digital commerce stack will depend on the specific needs and requirements of the online seller. For example, sellers who need to process payments quickly and efficiently may choose to use blockchain-based payment systems like NOWPayments, while those who require more advanced features and customization options may choose to use a cloud-based infrastructure provider like Cloudflare.
